raw_definitions: Definisi : adj & n 1. ( cardinal number ) lima: there are only ~ teachers in the whole school, hanya ada lima orang guru di sekolah itu; for ~ nights in a row, lima malam berturut-turut; 2. figure representing this number, /nombor, angka/ lima; 3. a. five o’clock, /pukul, jam/ lima: we have tea at ~, kami minum petang pd pukul lima; b. five minutes, lima minit: ~ past ten, pukul sepuluh lima minit; 4. size denoted by five, saiz lima; ~ day week, (sistem kerja) lima hari seminggu. (Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan)
